title: NASA POWER daily data at each site's point
note: temperature and rain columns feed the model; humidity, wind and radiation are kept in the files; see sites.csv and each site's constants.csv for the point and the period

title: SMAP L4 SPL4SMGP.008 root-zone soil moisture
note: calibration target; a 9 km model product, not a field measurement. AppEEARS point request: SPL4SMGP.008 layers sm_surface, sm_rootzone, sm_profile, 1 Apr 2015 to 7 Nov 2026, point -33.357778 -58.078806

title: SMAP L3 SPL3SMP-E.006 surface soil moisture
note: independent validation of the water dynamics. AppEEARS point request: SPL3SMP_E.006 AM and PM soil moisture with quality flags, 1 Apr 2015 to 7 Nov 2026, same point

title: XmartAgro producer survey, Nov 2026 (12 respondents: Soriano, Rio Negro, Paysandu)
note: rotations and unfavourable seasons as written by the producers; respondents are not named and localities are dropped

title: MODIS MOD13Q1.061 vegetation index, 250 m pixel at the site
note: independent check of the seasons the model finds stressed. AppEEARS point request: MOD13Q1.061 NDVI, EVI and pixel reliability, 18 Feb 2002 to 7 Nov 2026, same point

title: NASA GPM IMERG Final daily precipitation V07 (GPM_3IMERGDF), 0.1 degree cell at the site
note: independent check of the POWER rain; a Giovanni export downloaded by the team and kept unchanged in the site folder

title: Simulated soil-moisture sensor readings, one year
note: generated by the model with a soil it does not know, plus noise and bias; NOT a measurement, replaced by the real ESP32 series when it exists

title: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, tables 11, 12 and 22
note: Kc mid and end, depletion fraction p and stage lengths; Kc ini is an image on the page and was not read

title: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 33, yield response to water (Ky)
note: Ky of soybean, maize, wheat and sorghum read from a summary of table 24: verify against the original

title: Simulated fields, sensor nodes, producers and seasons of the learning layer
note: generated by the model from the tables in data/learning with a fixed seed; NOT measurements, replaced by real data when it exists

title: CONEAT soil groups of Uruguay (map and description of the groups)
note: optional soil-map module: the group of each field and its productivity index and dominant soil orders; the 120 MB shapefile is not kept in the repository, only the group table and the units found for the fields
